item.title: Brazil's presidential race heads to Lula–Bolsonaro run-off as right gains ground
item.description: Now there are two: Brazil heads into a runoff after a first round that failed to fully energize voters, setting the stage for a more polarized contest that Washington is watching very closely.

item.title: Trump names national intelligence chief Jay Clayton as new AI czar
item.description: Trump said Clayton will lead the White House's new "Super Intelligence Force," which will coordinate government engagement with artificial intelligence.

item.title: Cornell president calls gang rape allegations 'deeply disturbing'
item.description: Cornell president Michael I. Kotlikoff said his university "must do better" in a video statement. "This is a defining moment in Cornell's history," he added.

item.title: U.S. Marine arrested for alleged murder of a woman in Okinawa, Japan
item.description: Japanese police arrested a U.S. Marine in the alleged robbery and murder of a woman on Okinawa, officials said Sunday.

item.title: How the Cornell case is affecting women who have experienced sexual assault
item.description: The rape allegations that have emerged from a Cornell University frat house are leading many women to remember their own experiences — and call for a wider reckoning over sexual violence.

item.title: She died covering war for Fox News. Her parents blame the network — and a star reporter
item.description: The family members of two Fox News journalists killed while covering the war in Ukraine are suing the network, saying it put getting the story ahead of its people.

item.title: Latter-day Saints women turn away from scandal-plagued Republican candidate in Arizona
item.description: Arizona Republican candidate for Congress Mark Lamb has been accused of sexual misconduct while sheriff. His controversy is turning many voters away as Democrats see an opportunity in the red seat.

item.title: All's fair in love and 'War' — a well-cast, classy-trashy divorce drama
item.description: HBO's War is intended to be an anthology series about two dueling London law firms. The first season stars Dominic West and Sienna Miller as a high-profile couple in the midst of a very nasty divorce.
